acao.titulo: Rodar migrate e validar as 3 tabelas corrigidas
acao.comando_ou_input: podman exec codeigniter55100_php php spark migrate; DESCRIBE user_manager/user_profiles/user_roles
acao.saida_resumo: 'Migrations complete.' com as 3 migrations rodadas. DESCRIBE confirmou: user_manager sem uuid (username/password_hash/token/status/last_login_at presentes), user_profiles com uuid varchar(50) nullable presente, user_roles identica a versao anterior.
